endorsements.name: Vincent Wolterman
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-36967
endorsements.description: Zortam Mp3 Media Studio 27.60 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the library creation file selection process that allows remote code execution. Attackers can craft a malicious text file with shellcode to trigger a structured exception handler (SEH) overwrite and execute arbitrary commands on the target system.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Vincent Wolterman
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37234
endorsements.description: Internet Download Manager 6.38.12 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Scheduler component that allows local attackers to crash the application by supplying oversized input. Attackers can paste malicious data exceeding 5000 bytes into the 'Open the following file when done' field to trigger a denial of service condition.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 6.9)
